restaurantName: Hou Jie Lao Hua (216 Tonghu Road)
address: 216 Tonghu Road, Gulou, Fuzhou, China Mainland
bio: Close to scenic spots, this simple shop attracts locals and tourists alike. As its sign says, lao hua, or rice vermicelli in pork broth, is the signature dish. But their hand-pulled noodles and ribbon rice noodles are equally good. For toppings, opt for the classic combos, or customise your own: braised pork intestine and deep-fried dough stick deliver lovely textures and mop up the broth. Bone marrow dressed in scallion oil is also worth trying....
pageTitle: Hou Jie Lao Hua (216 Tonghu Road)
